tools.name: check_car_listing
tools.description: Use this when the user supplies a dealer vehicle listing and wants a best-practice score, missing data and prioritised fixes. Accepts at least a title (up to 300 characters) or description (up to 20,000), optional fields and up to 100 photo URL strings or a count. It does not fetch or scrape any web

tools.name: get_car_listing_checklist
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a static dealer vehicle-listing checklist for Germany, the US, the UK or a generic market, optionally for a new or used vehicle. Returns recommended fields, photo order, title pattern and description structure in English. It does not fetch or scrape any website or verify
